exploit_name: Balancer oracle deadlock from cumulative price weight
description: The TWAP calculation uses a complex denominator formula. If snapshot.averagePrice becomes zero or very small, division-by-zero or overflow can occur.
root_cause: The TWAP calculation uses a complex denominator formula. If snapshot.averagePrice becomes zero or very small, division-by-zero or overflow can occur.
fix_description: Add guards against zero/near-zero averagePrice. Simplify the TWAP formula to standard cumulative price deltas.
notes: Oracle becomes permanently unusable, blocking all dependent protocol operations.
